response.sql: WITH station AS (SELECT o.observstation, o.lunarstage, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS station_avg, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes AS t JOIN observatories AS o ON o.observstation = t.observstation GROUP BY o.observstation, o.lunarstage), phase AS (SELECT lunarstage, AVG(station_avg) AS avg_bandwidth_usage, SUM(telescope_count) AS telescope_count FROM station GROUP BY lunarstage) SELECT lunarstage, avg_bandwidth_usage, telescope_count, 1.0 * telescope_count / SUM(telescope_count) OVER () AS share_of_total FROM phase;

assumptions.assumption: “How many” counts matched telescopes, and their share is a fraction of all matched telescopes.

alternatives.interpretation: Count matched observatory stations with each phase, and calculate each phase’s share of matched stations.
